name: Taking the Plunge
source:
Welcome to your first day aboard the CRF New Providence, the world’s first underwater research complex! You’ve spent years striving to reach this point, you’re at the top of your field–so why do you feel so unsatisfied? Well, no matter, you have new coworkers to meet and the standard issue new-job bullshit to get through–you can worry about that other stuff later. Right?

Taking the Plunge is a story about being gay in your twenties, meeting new people, and trying to make the best of where you find yourself.

[From [url=https://haley-ct.itch.io/taking-the-plunge]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到世界上第一个水下研究综合体CRF新普罗维登斯号的第一天！你花了很多年的时间才达到这个目标，你已经在自己的领域中处于顶尖地位了，但为什么你会感到如此不满足呢？好吧，没关系，你还有新同事要见，还有标准的新工作废话要处理——你可以稍后再担心其他事情。正确的？

《Taking the Plunge》讲述了二十多岁的同性恋者结识新朋友，并努力充分利用自己的故事。

[来自[url=https://haley-ct.itch.io/taking-the-plunge]Itch.io[/url]]
